latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of book-cover-generator.

- Launches an AI-based tool for generating book covers via the Neta AI image generation API.
- Supports genre-specific covers for fantasy, romance, thriller, sci-fi, and non-fiction in portrait format.
- Includes options for custom image size and style reference.
- Requires a Neta API token for access (with free trial available).
- Provides quick start and installation instructions for indie authors and self-publishers.
